title: Envelope of a calibration file
description: Metadata that describe a calibration file: what it is, in which format, when it applies and where it comes from. It is the same in the FITS headers, the meta of an ECSV table and the meta object of a JSON file. New optional keys do not change the version of the envelope

envelope.description: Version of the envelope, defined by numina

type.description: Name of the type of the data in the DRP, as in the products of drp.yaml

format.description: Version of the format of the contents, defined by each type. Files without envelope are format 1

profile.description: UUID of the profile (configuration of the instrument), only if the data depend on it

tags.description: Tags compared by equality with those of the observation when the data are selected

conditions.description: Physical conditions of the data, to select the closest or to check a range

validity.description: Interval of dates in which the data can be used, in ISO 8601. Without end, the interval is open

provenance.description: Origin of the data: DRP and version, numina version, recipe, mode, block, input frames, creation date
